name: Mogami Hinagiku
source:
The warrior of the "Salvation Committee". Among the members, she's the newest arrival to this world—a first-year student.

Apparently summoned from a Japanese-styled (?) world, she gives an impression close to a feudal-era samurai as the [url=/c131389]protagonist[/url] knows it. A righteous person who declares without hesitation: "I fight to protect the weak and save the world!" Bright, bold, and loves the spotlight. Oh, and she's kind of dumb. Charges ahead shouting "Leave it to me!" and never dwells on failures... and so on.

[b]Ability: "Demon-Wail Crimson Lotus"[/b]
A talking sword. While devastating as a blade, it's also a reliable partner offering tactical support. ...Though its nagging mother-hen personality gets annoying sometimes (according to her).

[Translated from [url=https://whirlpool.co.jp/hajiron/character/chara02.php]official website[/url]]
